title: gymnadenia runei
intro: Gymnadenia runei, commonly known as the Summer Gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include being a potential source of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, contributing to its therapeutic use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in Gymnadenia runei include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its therapeutic actions. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
